subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should unauthorized turns retain model-visible schemas for `computer`, `cron`, `gateway`, and `nodes` when an immutable current-turn grant blocks execution before hooks and side effects?
rationale: The implementation can be mechanically reviewed, but choosing model-visible capability exposure instead of discovery-time filtering is a repository security and product-boundary decision.

options.title: Approve Stable Visibility
options.body: Keep schemas stable for cache reuse and require current-head proof that every native, CLI, and MCP path denies unauthorized calls before hooks and side effects.

options.title: Preserve Hidden Schemas
options.body: Retain discovery-time filtering and redesign cache stabilization without exposing protected tool capabilities to unauthorized turns.

recommendation.title: Approve Stable Visibility
recommendation.body: Keep schemas stable for cache reuse and require current-head proof that every native, CLI, and MCP path denies unauthorized calls before hooks and side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work covers the embedded runtime, Codex supervision, protected computer actions, and CLI/MCP authorization crossed by this decision.
